context:
Goal: a builder that failed twice gets the model you want on its third try.
Problem (rule): the rules say a builder's third try runs Opus, and you were relayed as saying Sonnet but hedged, so changing which model a failing builder gets needs your check.
Based on (ruling): own-round3-builder-sonnet (filed 00:04 CST Nov 16 from the consultant's relay) already rules Sonnet; it is re-asked because the consultant says the words were hedged and his first reading overreached.
Based on (ruling): decisions/agent-model-cap (your rulings of 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-06 set Sonnet as the ceiling, with Opus for a builder's third try by a standing grant that has no date); it is re-asked because the words below reverse that grant.
Based on (notes): you wrote in the census lane at 23:57 CST Nov 15 that the builder's third try should have run Sonnet, hedged with "i believe"; the consultant relayed it at 00:01 CST Nov 16, quoting you: "the builder round 3 shouldve ran sonnet too i believe. message consultant about this deviation u experienced". Your earlier word at 14:05 CST Nov 13 reads "no opus round 3 here just sonnet high" (the round 3 reviewer). Unmeasured: whether Opus on round 3 lands more fixes.
Waiting on: you, through the consultant.
Departs from: main — a builder's third try runs Opus (`roles-third-round-steps-up`, the agent-role-model guard); option b makes it Sonnet and rewrites both.
Meanwhile: lanes follow the rule as written.

lastAnswer.note: Owner, typed in the consultant's chat 00:04 CST Nov 16, verbatim: "B". A builder's third try runs Sonnet high. Relayed by the consultant; no page save.

why: The reported words are not typed or timed, and nothing measures cost against fixes; the rule stands until you say. The consultant leaned b if your word stands.
